standard.title: Methods of Measurement of Work in River Valley Projects (Dams and Appurtenant Structures) — Part 12: Topographical Surveys (नदी घाटी परयोजनाओ ंमें कायर्  मापन क पद्धित (बाँध और संबंिधत संरचनाए)ँ भाग 12 स्थलाकृितक सवक्षण) (First Revision)
standard.sector: Water Resources / Civil & Dam Work Measurement

sectional_committee.name: Measurement and Cost Analysis of Works for River Valley Projects Sectional Committee

standard.description: This standard specifies standard methods, billing frameworks, and technical criteria for measuring topographical survey work (including alignments of canals, drains, highways, and cross-section surveys) performed in river valley projects to ensure contractual transparency and uniform cost analysis.
standard.scope: This standard specifies standard methods, billing frameworks, and technical criteria for measuring topographical survey work (including alignments of canals, drains, highways, and cross-section surveys) performed in river valley projects to ensure contractual transparency and uniform cost analysis.

certification.description: Voluntary Measurement Code. Since IS 9401 (Part 12) is a standard method of measurement and quantity auditing rather than a physical consumer product, it does not carry an individual BIS 'ISI Mark' product stamp. However, its use is strictly mandated by the Central Water Commission (CWC), state water resources departments, public sector utilities (such as NHPC, BBMB, THDC, WAPCOS, SJVN), and civil auditing boards across India. It is universally incorporated into commercial tender specifications, construction contracts, and billing schedules of public works to determine contractors' payments, measure physical excavation quantities, and prevent contractual disputes. Precious metal hallmarking is completely inapplicable.
requirements: Mandates that topographical measurements, specifically cross-section surveys, must be carried out and recorded on a standardized linear basis (e.g., per running metre or kilometre).

Specifies that the topographical and cross-sectional surveys must cover and map specific key features, including alignments of canals, natural drainages, highways, and other similar linear elements of the river valley project.
Cross-sectional measurements must comprehensively include all individual work items, pegging, benchmarking, leveling, and clearance activities as specified under Clause 3.4 of the standard.
Integrates topographical surveying techniques and scales with the guidelines of IS 5497 to ensure appropriate contour resolutions and surveying accuracies are maintained across the project command.
